exemptions.test_the_reserved_code_cannot_be_confuse: ⚠️ INEXPRESSIBLE as a single-site mutation, recorded rather than faked (CLAUDE.md §8). The test reads only the GATE literal, while the pin test compares gate against guard. Moving one literal out of the legal range reddens the PIN claim first; reddening this claim alone needs BOTH literals moved together, which a probe's single old/new pair cannot express. Its content is not unwitnessed in effect: probe 8c proves the two literals are compared at all, and the range is a constant-time read a human can verify by inspection.
